item.title: When will ski resorts open in WA? La Niña off to a slow start
item.description: Low snow has delayed openings at some Washington ski resorts, but others, such as Mission Ridge, plan to open Thursday.

item.title: Man stabbed in neck during Seattle road rage incident
item.description: A person was stabbed in the neck during a road rage incident in downtown Seattle, and police have arrested a suspect.

item.title: Julian Love, Jarran Reed return to practice for Seattle Seahawks
item.description: Safety Julian Love, defensive tackle Jarran Reed, and wide receiver Dareke Young were all designated to return to practice for the Seattle Seahawks on Wednesday.

item.title: Arlington, WA ranch owner sentenced for child sex abuse
item.description: An Arlington horse ranch owner was sentenced to nearly 16 years in prison on Tuesday for sexually abusing three young girls he groomed.

item.title: Seattle woman’s finger bitten off in unprovoked assault
item.description: An 88-year-old woman says she was blindsided and violently attacked by a stranger in her own backyard — a daylight assault so brutal the attacker bit her finger off.

item.title: Federal judge blocks Trump's defunding of Planned Parenthood
item.description: A federal judge granted a preliminary injunction to block the Trump administration's attempt to defund Planned Parenthood, Washington State Attorney General Nick Brown announced Wednesday.

item.title: Is this objectively the best pizza in Western Washington?
item.description: A Kitsap County pizza maker has earned global recognition, becoming the first non-Italian to receive one of the industry’s most exclusive honors.

item.title: Seattle weather: Wet, warm and breezy Thursday into the weekend
item.description: Temperatures Thursday will be in the mid to upper 40s. It will be a wet start to the day Thursday with scattered showers into the evening.

item.description: Each country's path to lift the World Cup trophy will soon be decided. Here's how to watch the FIFA World Cup Final Draw in the Seattle area.

item.title: Two late power play goals give Seattle Torrent first win, 2-1, over Sirens
item.description: Alex Carpenter and Hilary Knight scored power play goals 22 seconds apart with less than two minutes to play and the Seattle Torrent got their first win in history, topping the New York Sirens 2-1.
